Absolutely! In informal language, getting "roasted" refers to being the subject of a playful, good-natured, and often merciless teasing or criticism. It's similar to being the focus of an intense joke session, typically in a group setting.

For example, during a comedy roast, a celebrity might be the target of humorous, often self-deprecating comments about their appearance, personality, or past mistakes. A famous example is when comedian Jeff Ross roasted Justin Bieber and said, "Justin, you're like the son I never had, but if I could have a do-over, I would have taken better care of my lawn." This comment highlights the friendly but critical nature of a roast.
